cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. This holiday photo would make a lovely anniversary card. Look at that sunset.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who's holding your hand at the edge?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Would you prefer the beach photo? More room for a message.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same person, same bracelet. Who is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That bracelet's exactly your colour. Shall I find you one for our anniversary?

mechanism: A treats questions about a suspicious companion as requests to approve photo selection and gifts, avoiding identity.
confusable: Unlike generic distraction, each new visible detail becomes the material for A's next authorized anniversary choice.
comparison: A holiday-photo identity shifts into a bracelet gift, unlike an unexplained key shifting into dinner guests.
seedUse: Retain the photo, hand and bracelet seed; make S01 govern the permissible interpretation of B's questions.
